Nightcap before heading home? The Choco Truffle Hazelnut was a delight but sweetness could be lowered down a notch. Menu offers coffee and non-coffee beverages as well as meals and shareable pica pica items…The cafe is spacious for group meetings and those working alone. Sadly, no sockets in sight….With hours to spare before closing, no qualms with service or even parking that Friday…

The cafe is spacious and they have wifi, just ask for the password from the counter. They have so much drinks to choose from and some snacks. If you have a hard time choosing with all the drink choices, you can ask the staff for their recommendations or best sellers. The place itself is pretty cute, check out photos for their menus and the place. I recommend the Cafe Mocha for hot drinks and the Choco Macadamia for cold drinks. Nachos Overload are definitely worth a try, not like any other nachos where the cheese and other ingredients are just sprinkled at the top. Their ingredients are distributed into the layers of nachos.

The coffee shop is very atmospheric, spacious and cozy. They have several drinks that are non-coffee base for the non-coffee drinkers making it a perfect coffee shop for kids too. We ordered Macadamia Chocolate Frappuccino and Hersheys Chocolate Frappuccino, and both are perfectly blended drinks. We also ordered cheesecake with strawberry topping and the slice is well portioned that it is not too big and not too small, just the perfect size for one to two persons. The shop is well-lit for those who want to study either at day or at night.

No sugarcoating it but it is overrated. They have a wide variety of coffee and non-coffee offers in their menu but most of those are NOT even available. They have free wifi but they only have one power outlet (as per their staffs) available if you want to charge your phone batteries (and you can’t bring extensions for safety purposes). Their staff are not really accommodating and the place is indeed crowded with rowdy youngsters.

Black Scoop Cafe Matina is spacious and accessible. They have a wide variety of drinks, pastries, and meals at reasonable prices. They have plenty of tables and chairs, good for individuals, pairs or small to large groups. The only downside for me is that it attracts a younger crowd (YA to toddlers that is) so the place can be quite rowdy at times. They have wifi and ample sockets for charging. CR is common to the commercial compuund though so you need to get out to use it. Well recommended cafe

Food is amiable and delicious to taste, and the servings are as advertised. However, for the Taiwanese chicken pops, I noticed there were a lot of batter than the meat itself. Serving time is neither fast nor slow and the service is plain acceptable, not that accommodating. The place is well maintained and cold, perfect for study place or chill with friends or family.

Not the best coffee in Davao, but it's certainly better than the institutional Davao brands here (ie Blugre). I'm glad to see them with a really wide menu. I just ordered a cappuccino and a slice of cake. Cake was alright, certainly not that sweet, which is good. Cappuccino was also good enough, and the ambiance is pretty good. I'd say it's definitely a competitor for the millennial market, and a cheaper alternative to Starbucks, etc. I might come back if I'm in the area, but I won't be craving it anytime soon if not at all.

It has a highly visible location and a dedicated parking area. Vehicles can also be parked in the spacious adjacent parking lot. The menu is varied, offering more than just coffee; there are other drinks and pastries. The interior is well-appointed and has plenty of tables. The lighting is good, and the coffee tastes quite good. Although I don't think they use specialty coffee beans, they provide a nice, sturdy cup holder. This is a nice added bonus for customers. The only downside is that their exhaust fan isn't very effective at removing smoke from the kitchen. We could smell the cooking fumes, which was a bit distracting while enjoying our drinks.
